content.text: Today's AI agent landscape is maturing rapidly across multiple fronts. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a major production milestone, with adoption tripling as enterprises move beyond experimentation. Model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups, signaling a shift toward more flexible, language-model-powered workflows. Meanwhile, tool-calling reliability has emerged as the new benchmark for frontier models, with developers demanding greater precision in how agents interact with external tools. Multi-agent swarms are advancing from demos into regulated enterprise workflows, and observability standards are finally emerging to trace agent decisions end to end. The era of reliable, scalable AI agents is no longer theoretical — it's arriving in production
